messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Symmetry-constrained ansatz parameterized by a few variables then globally optimized

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal configuration consists of 13 points with S4 symmetry about the center of the unit square: one at the center, four at the corners, four at the midpoints of the sides, and four interior points at positions (t,t), (1-t,t), (t,1-t), (1-t,1-t). This ansatz has a single parameter t, and the global optimum is achieved at t = (7-√5)/16 ≈ 0.2951, which equilibrates the three distinct triangle area classes so that all 286 triangles have minimum area exactly (3-√5)/32 ≈ 0.0301."}
